long_desc: It's got a wooden handle and a heavy bit on the end. It's heavy enough to smash a wall down, or break your toe if you're not careful!
A huge piece of iron the sailors use when mending chain. Probably too big to move - it's a miracle the ship is still afloat really!
A bit of wood for belaying ropes. Can you see any ropes that need belaying?
A really sharp knife, the kind sailors hold between their teeth when swinging from ropes to help them go OOOoooarrrrr properly.
Bulging sacks. How interesting - I wonder what is in them...
A lovely blingy gold coin! With this in your pocket and the right opportunity you just feel sure you could get off this boat!
